g.text: 70 × 50 mm • 24 × 18 holes • 2.54 mm pitch • all point-to-point wires are on rear.
Solid dots: through-hole leads. Square ports: rear-only cable attachment pads.
Coordinates are assigned by this drawing; supplier lettering may be on the opposite face.
C1/C3 0.1 µF · D1/D3 NTE585 · JP1 removable shunt (remove for USB)
D2 stays at the pump; C4 stays at the Hall sensor. Neither mounts on this board.

g.text: U1 notch ↑ • Q1/Q2 printed faces ↓ • D1 stripe → Q17 • D3 stripe → W18 • C2 + H02 / − H04
Grey squares: 9 × 9 mm mounting keep-outs. Drill centres: x=15/55, y=15/45 mm from front top-left.
Grid offsets are nominal. Verify the board and dry-fit C2 before drilling or soldering. This is not a 1:1 drill template.
Flip the board left ↔ right; top stays top. Pad names do not change.
Insulated wires cross without joining. Solder only at marked endpoints; bends are not joints.
Only W01, W02 and W05–W07 are short bare bus links. All other links are insulated.

g.title: H02: N02 → Battery negative / J1 sleeve
H05: P01 → Buck OUT+ (set to 5.0 V)
H07: R01 → Pump + / D2 striped end
H08: R02 → Pump − / D2 unstriped end
H11: U08 → Lock +5 V: A3144 pin 1 / C4
H12: V08 → Lock HALL: A3144 pin 3
H13: W08 → Lock SW: microswitch NO
H14: X08 → Lock GND: Hall pin 2 / COM / C4
